svg.aria-label: About Lakshya Lohani. I'm Lakshya Lohani, also known as Zenon - a founder and developer building software products that solve real problems. I work across full-stack development, AI integrations and backend systems, and enjoy taking an idea to a working product with clean interfaces and maintainable engineering.
